annotations.title: Add holidays to a custody calendar

description: Add a holiday rotation to a custody calendar made by make_custody_schedule: Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve/Day, Easter, US long weekends, UK bank holidays, Canadian and Australian public holidays, and school breaks alternating by year or split in half. Holidays override the regular rotation on those nights. Returns the updated calendar, overnight counts and new .ics and subscribe links.

items.description: A built-in holiday ({"holiday": "thanksgiving"}) or a dated span such as a school break ({"name": "Winter break", "start": "2026-12-19", "end": "2027-01-03"}; end = the last night). Built-in: thanksgiving, christmas-eve, christmas-day, new-years-eve, easter, memorial-day, independence-day, labor-day, halloween, mlk-day, presidents-day, easter-long-weekend, boxing-day, early-may-bank-holiday, spring-bank-holiday, summer-bank-holiday, family-day, victoria-day, canada-day, civic-holiday, thanksgiving-canada, australia-day, anzac-day, kings-birthday-australia.

evenYears.description: Who has it (or the first half) in even years. Default A.

rule.description: alternate = one parent each year (default); split = first half / second half, swapping each year; A or B = always that parent

schedule_url.description: Any link returned by make_custody_schedule (view, download or subscribe).

name: add_holiday_rotation
